description: Take-home pay for the same salary in the 50 states and DC in 2026, sorted from the highest. Useful to answer "which state lets me keep the most" or to price a move.

k401_percent.description: Pre-tax 401(k) contribution, percent of gross. Default 0.

salary.description: Annual gross salary in dollars. Give this or hourly_rate.

tax_year.description: Tax year, 2026 or 2027. Default: the year in force today (2026 now; 2027 from January 1, 2027).

name: compare_states
title: Compare take-home pay in every state
